## Evidence Review — Chapter 5B, All Lenses

All seven candidates derive from a single frozen source (SHA-256: `9284e94294ac9d6e565c3186433b2b7b26efb621396d3bc2850cfa654277db3d`), Acuerdo 173/2022 published at `sidof.segob.gob.mx`. Each excerpt maps directly to an identified Article in the document. Claims are accepted as written; no overstatement, date error, or attribution defect was found.

| evidence_id | Verdict | Key Finding |
|---|---|---|
| `EF-Ed8a8b3c457af` | **ACCEPT** | Excerpt confirms period 10–16 December 2022, automotive fuels, and Artículo Primero stimulus percentages. Dates, fuel types, and scope match exactly. |
| `EF-Eb0c3a683f23c` | **ACCEPT** | Excerpt is the full Article Cuarto table showing $0.0000 per liter for all three fuel categories. Quantities match precisely. |
| `EF-E71175c4b22c3` | **ACCEPT** | Excerpt is the complete Article Primero percentage table. All three values (26.96 %, 0.00 %, 59.77 %) are verbatim. |
| `EF-E10aa5c1053a9` | **ACCEPT** | TRANSITORIO ÚNICO entry-into-force clause and signature block confirm both the effective-date mechanism and the 8 December 2022 signing date. Suplencia role is explicit. |
| `EF-E170cfc59cffb` | **ACCEPT** | Full preamble names Karina Ramírez Arras, SHCP authority, and both enabling Decretos (27 Dec 2016 and 4 Mar 2022). Scope of published parameters matches the claim. |
| `EF-Ed453d3946dc0` | **ACCEPT** | Article Tercero reduced-IEPS cuota table is reproduced verbatim. All three peso-per-liter values are exact. |
| `EF-E5f02d2c14a2d` | **ACCEPT** | Article Segundo per-liter stimulus amounts are reproduced verbatim. All three values match. |

**No rejections or escalations.** All seven candidates are factually faithful to their hash-bound source excerpts.
